, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated the years of the show as 2001–2006, confusing Rose McGowan’s tenure with the show’s overall run. Charmed aired from 1998–2006; 2001–2006 were McGowan’s seasons. While the series identification (Charmed) was correct, this was the first factual error.
